entities.name: Hildegart Rodríguez Carballeira
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hildegart Leocadia Georgina Hermenegilda María del Pilar Rodríguez Carballeira was an activist for socialism and sexual revolution who was conceived and raised by her anti-theist, socialist, eugenicist, and feminist mother, Aurora Rodríguez Carballeira, as a prototype for the women of the future. She spoke four languages when she was eight years old, finished law school as a teenager, and was a leader of the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE) which she abandoned in favor of extreme Republicanism, joining the Federal Democratic Republican Party (PRDF).
